quarterly_data.signal: Acquisition (Test & Measurement): Emerson has acquired Glue Inc., maker of the AI-enabled validation and test software Glue Studio (AI capabilities for test generation and planning), to strengthen software-defined, data-centric capabilities across Test & Measurement's NI portfolio. Glue Studio's technology will be integrated into NI Nigel AI - which Emerson calls the industry's first AI specifically optimized for test and measurement workflows, embedded in NI software - to connect validation workflows, enhance traceability and extend AI-assisted test planning and validation across the engineering workflow.
